requirements.title: Independent C++17 build
requirements.requirement: Provide the library component and GoogleTest units as separate native C++17 targets; no OS or host-tool dependency enters the core.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Compile the configuration units; keep production implementation reserved for the developer.

requirements.title: Non-throwing result foundation
requirements.requirement: Define success/error alternatives with stable minimal error code and byte offset; returning any failure shall not require allocation or throw.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Unit-test minimal result construction in exceptions OFF/ON; no parser needed.

requirements.title: Fallible storage and accounting
requirements.requirement: Provide caller-supplied fallible storage, checked size arithmetic, ownership and cleanup primitives before implementing growing parser structures.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Fail each primitive allocation and verify explicit outcomes and balanced release.

requirements.title: Explicit input cursor
requirements.requirement: Consume immutable bytes with explicit length and end position; bound every read and preserve original byte locations.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Empty, embedded-zero and truncated buffers; no terminating NUL assumption.

requirements.title: Unicode source decoding
requirements.requirement: Decode the project UTF-8 transport to source characters without replacement; retain byte-to-source mapping.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Malformed, overlong, surrogate-encoded and out-of-range UTF-8; supplementary characters.

requirements.title: Character classification
requirements.requirement: Establish documented Unicode data for source classification used by whitespace and IdentifierName; classification has no locale dependency.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Category boundaries, non-ASCII and non-BMP handling; document supported Unicode version.

requirements.title: Line terminators
requirements.requirement: Recognize LF, CR, CRLF, U+2028 and U+2029 as line terminator sequences; keep CRLF as one sequence for location/continuation purposes.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Each sequence and EOF after CR; assert source spans.

requirements.title: Whitespace
requirements.requirement: Skip HT, VT, FF, SP, NBSP, BOM and other Unicode Zs whitespace, together with line terminators, between tokens.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Each admitted space before/after tokens; BOM both leading and between tokens.

requirements.title: Line comments
requirements.requirement: Skip // comments until a line terminator or EOF; comments are trivia rather than values.
requirements.unit_acceptance: All terminators, empty comment and EOF comment; validate non-ASCII source.

requirements.title: Block comments
requirements.requirement: Skip /* comments through the first */; do not nest comments, and report unterminated comments.
requirements.unit_acceptance: First closer, embedded opener and EOF at every suffix position.

requirements.title: Trivia composition
requirements.requirement: Permit any sequence of admitted spaces, line terminators and comments before/after tokens, without joining split tokens.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Mixed trivia; comments between tokens; 1/*x*/2 remains two tokens.

requirements.title: Punctuation tokens
requirements.requirement: Recognize exactly the structural punctuators { } [ ] : , outside strings/comments.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Every punctuator, adjacent punctuators and original spans.

requirements.title: String storage
requirements.requirement: Provide owned length-aware decoded-unit storage, preserving UTF-16 escape units including lone surrogates; define allocation-failure behavior.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Empty, NUL, supplementary scalar and unpaired unit round-trips without UTF-8 substitution.

requirements.title: Quoted string boundaries
requirements.requirement: Recognize single/double-quoted strings with matching closing delimiters; allow the other quote and ordinary source characters, rejecting raw CR/LF and unterminated strings.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Both delimiters, opposite quote, raw tab/control characters, raw CR/LF and EOF.

requirements.title: Simple character escapes
requirements.requirement: Decode escaped quotes, reverse solidus, b/f/n/r/t/v and zero; zero is valid only when not followed by a decimal digit.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Each decoded unit; accept zero at quote/EOF boundary only where the complete string is valid; reject zero followed by any digit.

requirements.title: Hexadecimal string escapes
requirements.requirement: Decode x followed by exactly two hexadecimal digits, in either hex-letter case; reject incomplete or nonhex escapes.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Lower/upper hex letters, boundary bytes and every truncation.

requirements.title: Unicode string escapes
requirements.requirement: Decode u followed by exactly four hexadecimal digits; preserve individual units and support escaped surrogate pairs.
requirements.unit_acceptance: BMP, paired/lone/reversed surrogate units and malformed/truncated hex.

requirements.title: Non-escape characters
requirements.requirement: For permitted characters without a special escape production, omit the reverse solidus and retain the character; reject escaped digits 1–9.
requirements.unit_acceptance: a/e/slash/space yield those characters; 8/9 fail; x/u cannot fall back after malformed escape.

requirements.title: String line continuations
requirements.requirement: Remove the reverse solidus and the following complete line terminator sequence from the decoded string.
requirements.unit_acceptance: LF, CR, CRLF, U+2028/U+2029 join unchanged surrounding text.

requirements.title: Raw separator warnings
requirements.requirement: Accept unescaped U+2028/U+2029 in strings and produce a warning without changing successful parsing.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Both raw separators, escaped equivalents, original warning spans and successful value.

requirements.title: Complete string lexer
requirements.requirement: Compose all string alternatives, validate delimiters and input consumption, and report lexical failures atomically.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Combine escapes/continuations; truncation at each byte; no partial successful string.

requirements.title: IdentifierName tokens
requirements.requirement: Recognize ES5 IdentifierName, including $, _, admitted Unicode starts/parts, ZWNJ/ZWJ continuation and reserved-word names.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Category representatives, digit-first rejection and reserved-word tokens.

requirements.title: Identifier Unicode escapes
requirements.requirement: Decode identifier uXXXX escapes before checking start/part legality and member-name equality.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Escaped valid names, illegal escaped start/part and equal decoded names.

requirements.title: Null and boolean classification
requirements.requirement: Classify lowercase null, true and false as value literals; preserve their admissibility as object IdentifierName tokens.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Exact spellings versus case/suffix variants; key-versus-value context classified without parsing containers.

requirements.title: Decimal numeric tokens
requirements.requirement: Recognize decimal integer, fraction and exponent alternatives, including leading/trailing decimal points and optional leading sign; reject illegal leading zeros and missing exponent digits.
requirements.unit_acceptance: 0/-0/+1/.5/5./5.e2/1E-2; reject 01, ., 1e and doubled signs.

requirements.title: Hexadecimal numeric tokens
requirements.requirement: Recognize signed or unsigned 0x/0X with one or more hexadecimal digits; reject incomplete prefix and invalid suffix.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Both prefixes/cases/signs; 0x, 0x1z and hex fractions fail.

requirements.title: Non-finite numeric tokens
requirements.requirement: Recognize Infinity and NaN with permitted leading signs and exact case.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Infinity/+Infinity/-Infinity and NaN/+NaN/-NaN; lowercase and suffix variants fail.

requirements.title: Token completion
requirements.requirement: Reject illegal suffixes and unsupported octal/binary/separator forms; never silently discard bytes or split invalid numeric/identifier spellings into accepted prefixes.
requirements.unit_acceptance: truex, 1foo, 0x1z, 0b1, 1_0 and split-token trivia; valid punctuation boundaries.

requirements.title: Owned numeric representation
requirements.requirement: Retain exact numeric spellings and represent signed decimal/hex and non-finite values without unintended floating-point rounding.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Integers beyond 2^53, huge exponents, negative zero and failure-safe owned storage.

requirements.title: Owned value/container model
requirements.requirement: Provide distinct null/boolean/string/number/array/object alternatives, ordered array elements and observable ordered duplicate object members.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Construct/inspect/move each variant before recursive parsing exists; explicit wrong-type results.

requirements.title: Resource guards
requirements.requirement: Validate limits and account for depth, nodes, members, strings, numeric spelling/exponents, bytes and work before parser growth; cleanup remains bounded.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Below/equal/above bounds and deterministic allocation/work exhaustion without recursive parser dependency.

requirements.title: Primitive value dispatcher
requirements.requirement: Convert completed string, number, null and boolean tokens into owned values; reject other identifiers in value position.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Each primitive root, unknown identifiers and allocation failure; containers still explicitly unsupported at this stage.

requirements.title: Recursive container engine
requirements.requirement: Implement bounded value-dispatch frames for arrays and objects together, with empty containers, nesting and punctuation expectations.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Empty arrays/objects and mixed nesting; allocate/check frames before descent; this step intentionally resolves mutual recursion together.

requirements.title: Array element grammar
requirements.requirement: Complete array element/separator states, heterogeneous ordered elements and one optional trailing comma; reject holes and misplaced separators.
requirements.unit_acceptance: [], mixed values, nested values, [1,]; reject [,], [1,,2] and missing commas.

requirements.title: Object member grammar
requirements.requirement: Complete quoted/identifier name, colon, value and separator states; permit one trailing comma and retain decoded names and every member.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Empty/nested objects, reserved-word/escaped keys and mixed values; reject missing name/colon/value/comma and doubled commas.

requirements.title: Duplicate-name policy
requirements.requirement: Keep all decoded duplicate members by default; optional rejection reports both occurrences. Compare exact decoded names without normalization/case folding.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Quoted/bare/escaped collisions, distinct case and normalization forms, nested object independence.

requirements.title: Complete document entry point
requirements.requirement: Accept one root value of any supported type surrounded by trivia; reject empty/trivia-only input, extra roots and trailing nontrivia.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Every root type, trailing EOF comment, {} {} and junk; atomic errors and reusable context.

requirements.title: Checked numeric operations
requirements.requirement: Provide non-throwing signed/unsigned/floating conversion and exact comparison under documented policies without boolean coercion, rounding/wrapping or locale dependence.
requirements.unit_acceptance: All destination bounds, nonintegral values, huge exponent, nonfinite and mathematical/lexical integer distinctions.

requirements.title: Owned document and diagnostics
requirements.requirement: Expose stable byte spans, warning/error locations and documented views; destruction/moves and input-buffer destruction do not invalidate owned data.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Overwrite input, move/destroy documents, CRLF/non-BMP offsets, failure injection and minimal error fallback.

requirements.title: Whole-grammar unit evidence
requirements.requirement: Map every JSON5 lexical/syntactic production and referenced ES5 alternative to named GoogleTest positive, negative, boundary and truncation cases; exercise resource failures and both exception modes.
requirements.unit_acceptance: No skipped grammar branches; fresh explicit unit evidence for accepted/rejected input and decoded content.

requirements.title: Full-support claim
requirements.requirement: Document language/Unicode versions, permitted limits and all deviations before claiming full JSON5 1.0.0 parsing support.
requirements.unit_acceptance: Review production-to-unit matrix, all preceding contracts and actual native results.
